item.title: Huang's return fails to dispel doubts as Nvidia shares drop
item.description:
Republicans and Democrats object over Trump’s role in Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO, following an affair with an alleged Chinese spy Democrats hit out at Nvidia and Trump over Huang’s return – US politics live Have you downloaded Meta’s AI assistant Muse or do you plan to? That phrase was on everyone’s lips almost 20 years ago when the Global Financial Crisis struck, and several major banks were bailed out. Given Nvidia’s pivotal role in the AI capex rollout, the implications of Huang’s reinstatement could be profound. item.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
item.description:
Blaze on ring road surrounding Egyptian capital injures at least 25 people and leaves cars and motorcycles charred A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a huge fire on a highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 30 people, Egyptian authorities said. The blaze on the ring road, a key artery that encircles the Egyptian capital, also injured at least 25 people and left more than two dozen cars and motorcycles charred, the public prosecutor’s office said in a statement. item.title: All hostages rescued after Colombian security forces storm supermarket, police say
item.description:
Unclear if ‘hostage-taker’ who was killed may have been a hostage as daylong siege in Cartagena shopping centre ends Colombian police have stormed a supermarket in one of the country’s most popular tourist cities, ending a daylong siege in which all the hostages were freed and one man police described as a hostage-taker was killed. Abelardo de la Espriella, the far-right president, travelled to the Caribbean port city of Cartagena to follow the final hours of negotiations and the tactical assault, in which special forces officers broke through blocked entrances and detonated stun grenades. item.title: Israeli judges recommend dropping most serious charges against Netanyahu
item.description:
Judges in the long-running corruption trial of Israeli caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu handed his defence a major boost on Wednesday in recommending the prosecution drop one of the cases in which he is accused of bribery. The recommendations, which came as Israel's longest-serving prime minister fights for his political survival, were immediately cheered by Netanyahu's right-wing allies who demanded the trial be brought to an end. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem.

Covered by 1 billionaire/family, 2 public.
Sources: BBC News, Bloomberg, France 24

item.title: King tides and big waves batter coastal California
item.description:
California spent two months preparing for El Niño. This week, as king tides and a powerful Thanksgiving winter storm batter the coast, the state will find out if it is ready. In September, Gov. Gavin Newsom proclaimed a state of emergency for El Niño. In the proclamation and subsequent executive orders , he directed agencies to speed up permits, move supplies and people and suspend some of the state’s own rules. The state Office of Emergency Services and Department of Water Resources asked operators of levees and dams to inspect facilities ahead of the storm. The state agencies prepared sandbags, portable flood barriers and materials for emergency repairs. The state is also deploying swiftwater rescue vehicles, boats and other specialized equipment. item.title: PSG's perfect Champions League record ends as Roma snatch 2-2 draw with late penalty
item.description:
Donyell Malen's 78th-minute penalty earned Roma a 2-2 draw at Paris Saint-Germain on Wednesday, ending the defending champions' perfect record in this season's Champions League. The result also halted PSG's 12-game winning streak in all competitions, leaving Real Madrid as the only team with a 100% record after five league-phase matches.

Sources: Al Jazeera English, France 24

item.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
item.description:
North Korea has ordered Switzerland to close its newly reopened diplomatic office. The dispute centers on Swiss sanctions against a camp accused of indoctrinating Ukrainian children from Russian-occupied territories.
